tools.name: get_facility_info
tools.description: Basic facts about Waynesville Smart Storage (Waynesville, NC): contact, website, how renting works.

tools.name: list_available_units
tools.description: Current monthly price, one-time admin fee and number of available units for each size/type. Optionally filter by size (e.g. "10x10") and/or type ("drive_up" or "climate_controlled").

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Create a secure, pre-filled booking link for a size/type that is currently available. The person opens the link to choose protection, e-sign the lease, upload ID and pay — nothing is reserved or charged until they do. Requires the person's consent to be contacted at the email given.
